_comment: Copy to sonelle.config.json (gitignored). 'hub' = your workspace path (default '.' = the sonelle folder; point it at your real registry to route those projects). 'models': the ORCHESTRATOR (the session you talk to) is ALWAYS your max model+effort. LANES (workers) default to laneDefault/laneEffort and a permission mode; per-lane override via :team proj bugs=opus,triage=haiku:medium. Models: haiku | sonnet | opus | claude-fable-5. Effort: low | medium | high | xhigh. Permission mode: default | acceptEdits | bypassPermissions | plan (lanePermissionMode for workers; optional orchestratorPermissionMode for the boss - unset = inherit your global default).
